core.title: 8/32 Inch Door Closer Sex Bolts, 4 Pack
tags: global door controls sex bolts for closers

text.description_html:
4 Pack - 8/32" Door Closer Sex Bolts

This is a 4 pack of 8/32" Door Closer Sex Bolts for thru-bolt mounting a TC901 Low Profile Residential Door Closer. Often used to mount closers on aluminum framed, composite and wooden doors (can be used on any material door). Thru-bolt mounting greatly increases holding strength so the door closer does not rip off the door.

*Packaged as a set of 4 (4 sleeves and 4 screws).
Enough to mount 1 door closer.
